choice.basis: The chart's Y-axis is inverted, with '0.0' at the top and '1.2' at the bottom (multiplied by 1e6). The X-axis displays dates in reverse chronological order from left to right, starting with 'Nov 20' and ending with 'Jun 26'. The blue data line starts at the bottom-left (Nov 20, near the 1.2 mark, representing ~1.25e6 samples) and trends upward toward the top-right (Jun 26, near the 0.4 mark, representing ~0.4e6 samples). Because the axis is inverted, the visual 'upward' trajectory on the page actually corresponds to a numerical decrease in the count of samples tested over the reporting window. A declining volume pattern maps to the declining-volume outreach review option.
choice.option_label: Route the testing-volume record to declining-volume outreach review
